memories.text: I am on a road and should keep going forward toward the village square.
I am on a road and should keep going forward toward the village square.
Woke up at motel area on Day 1 at 08:00 - need to get to village square!
Still on the road heading toward village square - saw businesses and people ahead!

I'm on a main street with businesses - Motel, Don's Donuts, Auto Service on the left, and County Sheriff, Gas Station on the right. Lots of people around! Keep going forward toward the village square!
Still heading forward on main street toward village square - saw Donut shop, Sheriff's office, Gas Station, and lots of people around!
Still on main street moving toward village square - vision glitched but I'll keep wandering forward!
Still on main street with American Bank on left and Gas Station on right - lots of people around! Keep going forward toward village square!
Saw an unknown person on the left side of main street near a pawn shop - greeted them!
Moving forward on main street toward village square - saw Fruit Market, church, water tower, windmill, red truck, and lots of people around!
Still on main street moving toward village square - saw liquor store, general store, church, and several people ahead!
Still heading toward village square on main street - saw gun store, clothes store, church, gas station, and several people around!

Still moving forward on main street toward village square - saw store, licenses building, yellow truck, windmill, yellow vending machine, and building with blue roof. Unknown people ahead on the left!
Still moving forward on main street toward village square - saw gun store, licenses building, wind turbine, recycling bins, and several people ahead!
At gun store area on main street - saw people near gun store entrance, need to greet them!

Woke up Day 1 at 08:00 at sheriff motel area—village square is forward on main street!
Encountered people on main street near motel and gas station area on Day 1 - greeted them while continuing toward village square!
Moving forward down main street toward village square - saw many people near Don's Donuts and sheriff station area!
Moving forward on main street toward village square - saw many people near shops and gas station!
Still heading forward down main street toward village square - saw many people at American Bank and Gas Station area!
Still heading forward on main street toward village square - passed bank, auto service, pawn shop, and gas station with many people around!
Greeted unknown person near pawn shop on main street on Day 1 at 08:07—still heading toward village square!
Day 1 08:00 - woke up at motel, heading forward on main street to village square!
Day 1 08:04 - still on main street near motel, greeted another unknown person, continuing toward village square!
Day 1 08:07 - Still on main street near motel with sheriff building and auto service around, lots of people ahead! Keep going forward to village square!
Day 1 08:10 - Still on main street near sheriff and auto service, lots of folks around! Keep pushing forward to village square!
Day 1 08:11 - Still on main street heading forward toward village square! Saw lots of people near Don's Donut and gas station!
Day 1 08:12 - Still pushing forward on main street! See lots of people, bank, gas station, and traffic light ahead - village square must be very close now!
